proves.claim: A seat holding one claimed item whose gate went red gets no new claim from next, and the same seat with a gate-pending item still gets one.

cli.io-next-trunk-claims.red-held-seat-g.why: Without it, a seat whose own gate went red is handed a second build while other seats get an empty next.

proves.claim: Once the seat resubmits and the red item awaits its gate again, next gives a claim again.
